I recently had the privilege of visiting DR.PEVEKAR'S LABORATORY for a blood test, and I am truly impressed with the exceptional service I received. She patiently listened to my worries and then shared a heartwarming anecdote about a 5-year-old who fearlessly gave a sample the previous day. Her thoughtful approach instantly put me at ease.

The professionalism and expertise displayed by the laboratory staff were truly remarkable. The blood sample collection process was quick and surprisingly painless, all thanks to the phlebotomist's proficiency. I was amazed at how smoothly everything went, especially given my needle-related apprehensions.

DR.PEVEKAR'S LABORATORY has undoubtedly won my confidence, not only for their technical competence but also for their compassionate care.
